title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has reviewed the 2020 Committee report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards and says it will work to create clear rules and guidelines for AI use. It plans to invest in safety research, improve transparency, and collaborate with industry and public stakeholders to build trust in AI technologies.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual’s policy outlines how artificial intelligence can be used in the qualifications sector, emphasizing fairness, transparency, and the preservation of exam integrity. It sets out safeguards, monitoring protocols, and coordination with the Secretaries of State for Education, Science and Business to ensure responsible AI deployment.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report looks at how AI developers use copyrighted material, weighing the legal, ethical, and practical effects on creators and users. It offers recommendations to help balance innovation with respect for copyright rights, aiming to guide responsible AI development.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has issued a response to the House of Lords Select Committee’s report titled “AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency.” In its reply, the government outlines the measures and priorities it will adopt to address the report’s findings and strengthen the country’s AI strategy.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document explains the purpose and duties of a committee that will review how artificial intelligence should fit with public standards, including background information and guidance for members. It sets out the committee’s scope, goals, and key questions to help ensure AI systems are developed and used responsibly.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee regarding governance of artificial intelligence. The committee is conducting an inquiry to examine and develop governance frameworks for AI.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy examines how artificial intelligence affects the rules governing medical products, highlighting the need for updated regulations. It calls for implementing the AI White Paper principles to ensure safety, transparency, and accountability in medical AI technologies.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the armed forces the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential AI organisation for a nation of its size. It sets a vision to harness AI to strengthen security, improve operational performance and lead globally in defense technology.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport Artificial Intelligence Action Plan explains how the Department for Transport will work with the transport sector to use AI to improve safety, efficiency and innovation, while also addressing any potential risks. It sets out guidelines for responsible implementation so that AI benefits are realised without compromising public trust or safety.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This report examines how copyright works are being used in AI development under the Data (Use and Access) Act's Section 137. It tracks progress, identifies challenges, and outlines regulatory recommendations to balance innovation with copyright protection.
